repairs.cause: Compensated sum rounded before division by non-power-of-two 5120; changes activation quantization codes.

repairs.cause: Transposed tiled reduction loses cancellation residuals.
repairs.fix: Sophon opts into the existing native GPU F32 dot mode.

repairs.cause: Long kernels did not preserve the shared CPU SIMD dot reduction.
repairs.fix: Reuse f32_dot.glsl for native SIMD lanes and retain scalar tails/dilated semantics.

repairs.cause: Online rescaling changes cancellation; host expf has one-ULP error on real inputs, amplified downstream.
repairs.fix: GPU normalizes before V accumulation using existing accurate exp/divide helpers; Sophon Flow explicitly uses standard-library F64 exp rounded to F32. Other CPU callers retain f32::exp.

repairs.cause: 16 NEON lanes used instead of native CPU 4 lanes; 33.3 percent error on cancelling inputs.
repairs.fix: Select native four-lane NEON or two eight-lane AVX2 streams and an unrounded scalar fallback; default rounded-input modes unchanged.
